title: Upload and attach an Expo image under session custody

competitor.concept: generateUploadUrl — a mutation-callable action that mints a short-lived signed URL; the client POSTs the raw file bytes to that URL to obtain a storage ID, then a second mutation writes that storage ID onto a document field (typically v.id('_storage')) to attach it.

Supabase Storage — supabase.storage.from(bucket).upload(path, file) uploads a file directly to a bucket from the client (authorized by Storage RLS policies on storage.objects), returning a path that is then stored as a plain string column on a table row to associate it with a record.
